title: Backward-Consistent Diffusion Sampling for Sparsely Observed PDE Inverse Problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.04624v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recovering Partial Differential Equation (PDE) coefficient fields from extremely sparse observations is a severely ill-posed inverse problem for which generative machine learning methods (e.g., diffusion models) have become a leading way to encode the prior. Recent state-of-the-art diffusion solvers lift these priors to function spaces, finding a physics-consistent reconstruction in the output space of the diffusion denoiser. We prove that, in a discontinuous PDE setting, output space methods can result in failure to appropriately minimize the unobserved error with the correct coefficient field. Consequently, we propose Function Space Backward-Consistent Sampling (FunBCS), an input space optimization approach for solving PDE problems which aims to find the best input such that the denoiser reconstruction is physics-consistent. We then prove that FunBCS appropriately minimizes the unobserved error, unlike output space optimization met

translated_title: 面向稀疏观测偏微分方程逆问题的后向一致扩散采样
translated_abstract: 从极其稀疏的观测中恢复偏微分方程（PDE）系数场是一个严重病态的逆问题，生成式机器学习方法（例如扩散模型）已成为编码先验的主流方式。近期最先进的扩散求解器将这些先验提升到函数空间，在扩散去噪器的输出空间中寻找物理一致的重构。我们证明，在不连续PDE的设定下，输出空间方法可能无法用正确的系数场适当地最小化未观测误差。因此，我们提出了函数空间后向一致采样，这是一种用于求解PDE问题的输入空间优化方法，旨在找到最佳输入使得去噪器的重构是物理一致的。随后我们证明，与输出空间优化方法不同，FunBCS能够适当地最小化未观测误差。
tldr: 该论文提出FunBCS——一种输入空间优化方法，通过寻找使去噪器重构物理一致的最佳输入，证明了其在不连续PDE逆问题中能够正确最小化未观测误差，而现有输出空间方法则无法做到。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes FunBCS, an input space optimization approach for diffusion-based PDE inverse problems, and proves it appropriately minimizes unobserved error in discontinuous PDE settings where output space optimization methods fail.
